title: Far right achieves historic result in Germany's Saxony-Anhalt regional elections
subhead: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) party, founded in 2013, recorded its best-ever result in this former East German state on Sunday, September 6, as Chancellor Friedrich Merz's party collapsed. However, the AfD cannot govern alone at this stage.

title: Le Pen focuses on AC and sovereignty to tackle climate change
subhead: 'Candidates and the climate' (1/5). The far-right Rassemblement National party and its leader Marine Le Pen advocate a 'positive' approach to environmentalism, focused on reindustrializing France and expanding air conditioning – proposals whose costs remain unclear.

title: Water is at heart of economic tensions between Mexico and the US
subhead: Bilateral agreements on the use of river water and shared groundwater between the US and Mexico are no longer enough to prevent conflicts between the two countries. The Trump administration has used the issue to put pressure on Mexico.

title: Putin, war leader and election campaign chief, prepares Russia for military escalation
subhead: For the first time since the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Russians will elect their MPs between September 18 and 20. Orchestrated by the Kremlin, this vote carries no real electoral stakes and serves above all as a tool to rally support for the war effort.
